purpose: Artifact integrity and known model interface/provenance metadata. This manifest does not establish model quality or suitability for farm decisions.

runtime_constraints.python: Use a Python version supported by the pinned dependencies; the repository recommends Python 3.11-3.13.
runtime_constraints.scikit_learn: 1.6.1 (pinned in requirements.txt; the serialized sklearn models were saved with this version)

artifacts.format: joblib/pickle dictionary containing a scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier
artifacts.target: crop label; 22 classes are stored in the model
artifacts.score_semantics: predict_proba ranking score; calibration and decision meaning are undocumented
known_gaps: Feature units and rainfall reference period are undocumented
Training data source and geographic coverage are undocumented
No evaluation or probability calibration results are included

artifacts.format: joblib/pickle dictionary containing a scikit-learn MultiOutputClassifier and encoders
artifacts.output_semantics: Encoded nutrient ratings, not fertilizer product or application-rate recommendations
known_gaps: Training data source, geography, and label definitions are undocumented

artifacts.target: predicted_price; currency and weight/quantity unit are undocumented
known_gaps: Price source, currency, quantity unit, and forecast horizon are undocumented
Training data date range and evaluation results are undocumented

artifacts.format: FAISS vector index and serialized text chunks
artifacts.corpus_source: kisanai_chunks.pkl contains 55 chunks from /content/crop_dataset/government_schemes_dataset.csv; source provenance and publication date are unverified
known_gaps: Document sources, publication dates, coverage, and chunking provenance are undocumented

disease_model.class_labels: Ordered list in services/disease.py, copied from the supplied inference app
disease_model.training_dataset: PlantVillage as reported by the source project; not independently verified
disease_model.evaluation_metrics: Source project reports 98.75% test accuracy; local field performance is unknown
known_gaps: Not validated on local field images
Predicted score is not calibrated confidence
No treatment recommendations are linked to predictions
